cardOverview.overviewText: A Patanjali Vishisht card delivering higher Patanjali purchase rewards, milestone vouchers, and lifestyle benefits for loyal customers.

items.child: 10% cashback at Patanjali online and offline stores, on transactions of INR 500 or more.

benefitRows.name: Patanjali
benefitRows.description: 10% cashback at Patanjali online and offline stores, on transactions of INR 500 or more.
benefitRows.offer: Get 10% cashback at Patanjali online and offline stores, on transactions of INR 500 or more. Earn monthly cashback of up to INR 500
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, pay at Patanjali stores (online/offline) with transactions over ₹500 using your RBL Patanjali Vishisht credit card. Cashback capped at ₹500 monthly. Contact RBL Bank at 1860 123 4455 for assistance.
